skitter-smack.name: Golpe Rastrero

sword-shield.text: Ataca al objetivo por la espalda de forma subrepticia y además reduce su Ataque Especial.

legends-arceus.text: The user skitters behind the target to attack. This also lowers the target's Sp. Atk stat.

scarlet-violet.text: The user skitters behind the target to attack. This also lowers the target's Sp. Atk stat.

skitter-smack.effect: Lowers the target’s Special Attack by one stage.

burning-jealousy.name: Envidia Ardiente

sword-shield.text: Ataca al objetivo con la energía generada por la envidia y causa quemaduras a los Pokémon cuyas características hayan aumentado en ese turno.

legends-arceus.text: The user attacks with energy from jealousy. This leaves all opposing Pokémon that have had their stats boosted during the turn with a burn.

scarlet-violet.text: The user attacks with energy from jealousy. This leaves all opposing Pokémon that have had their stats boosted during the turn with a burn.

burning-jealousy.effect: Burns the target if it had a state stage raise this turn.

lash-out.name: Desahogo

sword-shield.text: Ataca al rival presa de la rabia. Si el usuario ha sufrido una reducción de características en ese turno, la potencia del movimiento se duplica.

legends-arceus.text: The user lashes out to vent its frustration toward the target. If its stats were lowered during the turn, the power of this move is doubled.

scarlet-violet.text: The user lashes out to vent its frustration toward the target. This move's power is doubled if the user's stats were lowered during this turn.

lash-out.effect: Power doubles if the user had a stat stage lowered this turn.

poltergeist.name: Poltergeist

sword-shield.text: El usuario ataca utilizando el objeto que lleva el rival. Si no tiene ninguno equipado, el movimiento falla.

legends-arceus.text: The user attacks the target by controlling the target's item. The move fails if the target doesn't have an item.

scarlet-violet.text: The user attacks by controlling the target's item. This move fails if the target isn't holding an item.

poltergeist.effect: Fails if the target has no held item.

sword-shield.text: El usuario libera un gas cáustico que envuelve a todos los que se encuentren alrededor y derrite por completo los objetos que lleven equipados.

coaching.name: Motivación

sword-shield.text: El usuario imparte indicaciones precisas a sus aliados, que ven aumentados su Ataque y su Defensa.

legends-arceus.text: The user properly coaches its ally Pokémon, boosting their Attack and Defense stats.

scarlet-violet.text: The user properly coaches its ally Pokémon, boosting their Attack and Defense stats.

coaching.effect: Raises the target's Attack and Defense by 1 stage. Fails if there is no ally adjacent to the user.

flip-turn.name: Viraje

sword-shield.text: Tras atacar, el usuario da paso a toda prisa a otro Pokémon del equipo.

legends-arceus.text: After making its attack, the user rushes back to switch places with a party Pokémon in waiting.

scarlet-violet.text: After making its attack, the user rushes back to switch places with a party Pokémon in waiting.

flip-turn.effect: User must switch out after attacking.

triple-axel.name: Triple Axel

sword-shield.text: Patea hasta tres veces seguidas y cada vez más fuerte.

legends-arceus.text: A consecutive three-kick attack that becomes more powerful with each successful hit.

scarlet-violet.text: A consecutive three-kick attack that becomes more powerful with each successful hit.

triple-axel.effect: Hits three times, increasing power by 100% with each successful hit.

sword-shield.text: Ataca al adversario golpeándolo dos veces con las alas.

legends-arceus.text: The user slams the target with its wings. The target is hit twice in a row.

scarlet-violet.text: The user slams the target with its wings to inflict damage. The target is hit twice in a row.

sword-shield.text: Ataca al objetivo arrojándole arena a temperaturas muy elevadas. Puede causar quemaduras.

legends-arceus.text: The user throws scorching sand at the target to attack. This may also leave the target with a burn.

scarlet-violet.text: The user throws scorching sand at the target to attack. This may also leave the target with a burn.

jungle-healing.name: Cura Selvática

sword-shield.text: Al entrar en plena armonía con la selva, el usuario cura problemas de estado y restaura PS no solo de sí mismo, sino también de los aliados presentes en el terreno.

legends-arceus.text: The user becomes one with the jungle, restoring HP and healing any status conditions of itself and its ally Pokémon in battle.

scarlet-violet.text: The user becomes one with the jungle, restoring HP and curing status conditions for itself and its ally Pokémon currently in the battle.

jungle-healing.effect: Each Pokemon on the user's side has its status condition healed and restores 1/4 of its maximum HP, rounded up.

sword-shield.text: Golpe devastador que requiere un absoluto dominio de las artes siniestras. Siempre asesta un golpe crítico.

legends-arceus.text: The user, having mastered the Dark style, strikes the target with a fierce blow. This attack always results in a critical hit.

scarlet-violet.text: The user, having mastered the Dark style, strikes the target with a fierce blow. This move always lands a critical hit.

surging-strikes.name: Azote Torrencial

sword-shield.text: El usuario, dominador absoluto del líquido elemento, golpea hasta tres veces con movimientos fluidos. Siempre asesta un golpe crítico.

legends-arceus.text: The user, having mastered the Water style, strikes the target with a flowing motion three times in a row. This attack always results in a critical hit.

scarlet-violet.text: The user, having mastered the Water style, strikes the target with a flowing motion three times in a row. This move always lands a critical hit.

surging-strikes.effect: Hits three times. Always scores a critical hit.

thunder-cage.name: Electrojaula

sword-shield.text: El objetivo queda atrapado en una jaula electrificada que permanece en el terreno de cuatro a cinco turnos.

legends-arceus.text: The user traps the target in a cage of sparking electricity for four to five turns.

scarlet-violet.text: The user traps the target inside a cage of sparking electricity that inflicts damage for four to five turns.

thunder-cage.effect: Prevents the target from fleeing and inflicts damage for 2-5 turns.

dragon-energy.name: Dracoenergía

sword-shield.text: El usuario convierte su fuerza vital en una energía con la que ataca al objetivo. Cuantos menos PS tenga el usuario, menor será la potencia del movimiento.

legends-arceus.text: Converting its life-force into power, the user attacks opposing Pokémon. The lower the user's HP, the lower the move's power.

scarlet-violet.text: Converting its life-force into power, the user attacks opposing Pokémon. The lower the user's HP, the lower the move's power.

dragon-energy.effect: Inflicts more damage when the user has more HP remaining, with a maximum of 150 power.

freezing-glare.name: Mirada Heladora

sword-shield.text: A través de sus ojos emite poderes psíquicos con los que ataca al objetivo, al que puede llegar a congelar.

legends-arceus.text: The user shoots its psychic power from its eyes to attack. This may also leave the target frozen.

scarlet-violet.text: The user shoots its psychic power from its eyes to attack. This may also leave the target frozen.

freezing-glare.effect: Has a chance to freeze the target.

sword-shield.text: El usuario convierte su ira en un aura flamígera para lanzar su ataque. Puede amedrentar al objetivo.

legends-arceus.text: The user transforms its wrath into a fire-like aura to attack. This may also make opposing Pokémon flinch.

scarlet-violet.text: The user transforms its wrath into a fire-like aura to attack. This may also make opposing Pokémon flinch.

thunderous-kick.name: Patada Relámpago

sword-shield.text: El usuario desconcierta al rival con movimientos centelleantes y le propina una patada. Baja la Defensa del objetivo.

legends-arceus.text: The user overwhelms the target with lightning-like movement before delivering a kick. This also lowers the target's Defense stat.

scarlet-violet.text: The user overwhelms the target with lightning-like movement before delivering a kick. This also lowers the target's Defense stat.

thunderous-kick.effect: Lowers the target’s Defense by one stage after inflicting damage.

glacial-lance.name: Lanza Glacial

sword-shield.text: El usuario ataca al objetivo lanzándole un carámbano de hielo envuelto en una ventisca.

legends-arceus.text: The user attacks by hurling a blizzard-cloaked icicle lance at opposing Pokémon.

scarlet-violet.text: The user attacks by hurling a blizzard-cloaked icicle lance at opposing Pokémon.

glacial-lance.effect: Causa daño sin un efecto adicional.

astral-barrage.name: Orbes Espectro

sword-shield.text: El usuario ataca al objetivo lanzándole una ingente cantidad de pequeños fantasmas.

legends-arceus.text: The user attacks by sending a frightful amount of small ghosts at opposing Pokémon.

scarlet-violet.text: The user attacks by sending a frightful amount of small ghosts at opposing Pokémon.

astral-barrage.effect: Causa daño sin un efecto adicional.

eerie-spell.name: Conjuro Funesto

sword-shield.text: El usuario ataca con un poder psíquico de inmensa potencia y elimina 3 PP del último movimiento que haya usado el objetivo.

legends-arceus.text: The user attacks with its tremendous psychic power. This also removes 3 PP from the target's last move.

scarlet-violet.text: The user attacks with its tremendous psychic power. This also drains 3 PP from the move last used by the target.

eerie-spell.effect: The target loses 3 PP from the last move it used.

legends-arceus.text: The user lashes out at the target with ruinous claws, aiming to land a critical hit. This may also leave the target poisoned, paralyzed, or drowsy.

scarlet-violet.text: The user lashes out at the target with ruinous claws. This may also leave the target poisoned, paralyzed, or asleep.

legends-arceus.text: Cloaking itself in psychic energy, the user slams into the target. This may also raise the user’s defensive stats.

scarlet-violet.text: Cloaking itself in psychic energy, the user slams into the target. This also boosts the user’s Defense stat.

legends-arceus.text: The user swaps its offensive and defensive stats.

scarlet-violet.text: The user swaps its Attack and Defense stats.

legends-arceus.text: The user swings its stone axes at the target, aiming to land a critical hit. Stone splinters left behind by this attack continue to damage the target for several turns.

scarlet-violet.text: The user swings its stone axes at the target. Stone splinters left behind by this attack float around the target.

legends-arceus.text: The user attacks by wrapping the target in fierce winds brimming with love and hate. This move’s additional effects depend on the user’s form.

scarlet-violet.text: The user attacks by wrapping opposing Pokémon in fierce winds brimming with love and hate. This may also lower their Attack stats.

legends-arceus.text: The user strengthens itself with a mysterious power. If it excels in offense, its offensive stats are raised. If it excels in defense, its defensive stats are raised.

scarlet-violet.text: The user attacks by emitting a mysterious power. This also boosts the user’s Sp. Atk stat.

legends-arceus.text: The user rampages and spews vicious flames to inflict damage on the target, then becomes fixated on using this move.

scarlet-violet.text: The user rampages around spewing flames for two to three turns. The user then becomes confused.

legends-arceus.text: The user shrouds itself in water and slams into the target with its whole body to inflict damage. This also damages the user and raises the user’s action speed.

scarlet-violet.text: The user shrouds itself in water and slams into the target with its whole body to inflict damage. This also damages the user quite a lot.

legends-arceus.text: The user launches its amassed chlorophyll to inflict damage on the target. This also damages the user and lowers the user's action speed.

scarlet-violet.text: The user launches its amassed chlorophyll to inflict damage on the target. This also damages the user.

legends-arceus.text: The user hurls giant chunks of ice at the target to inflict damage.

scarlet-violet.text: The user hurls giant chunks of ice at the target to inflict damage. This may also make the target flinch.

legends-arceus.text: The user performs a dance to usher in victory. This raises the user’s offensive and defensive stats and increases the damage dealt by the user’s moves by 50 percent.

scarlet-violet.text: The user performs an intense dance to usher in victory, boosting its Attack, Defense, and Speed stats.

legends-arceus.text: The user smashes into the target in a full-body tackle. This also lowers the user’s defensive stats.

scarlet-violet.text: The user smashes into the target in a full-body tackle. This also lowers the user’s Defense and Sp. Def stats.

legends-arceus.text: The user launches countless toxic barbs to inflict damage. This may also poison the target. This move’s power is doubled if the target has a status condition.

scarlet-violet.text: The user launches countless toxic barbs to inflict damage. This may also poison the target. This move’s power is doubled if the target is already poisoned.

legends-arceus.text: The user slashes the target with aura-enriched wings. This also raises the user's action speed. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.

scarlet-violet.text: The user slashes the target with aura-enriched wings. This also boosts the user's Speed stat. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.

legends-arceus.text: The user attacks its target with spine-chilling resentment. This may also leave the target with frostbite. This move's power is doubled if the target has a status condition.

scarlet-violet.text: The user attacks the target with spine-chilling resentment. This also lowers the target’s Attack stat.

legends-arceus.text: The user makes its skin as hard as an iron shield, raising its defensive stats. Incoming moves also become more likely to miss.

scarlet-violet.text: The user makes its skin as hard as an iron shield, sharply boosting its Defense stat.

legends-arceus.text: The user delivers an axe kick, then fires three arrows. This raises the chance of its future attacks landing critical hits and also lowers the target's defensive stats.

scarlet-violet.text: The user kicks, then fires three arrows. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit and may also lower the target’s Defense stat or make it flinch.

legends-arceus.text: The user attacks with myriad fireballs. This may also leave the target with a burn. This move's power is doubled if the target has a status condition.

scarlet-violet.text: The user attacks with myriad fireballs. This may also leave the target with a burn. This move's power is doubled if the target has a status condition.

legends-arceus.text: The user slashes its shell blade at the target, aiming to land a critical hit. Shell splinters left behind by this attack will continue to damage the target for several turns.

scarlet-violet.text: The user slashes its shell blade at the target. Shell splinters left behind by this attack remain scattered under the target as spikes.

legends-arceus.text: The user attacks with savagely cold winds that cause both body and spirit to tremble. This may also leave the target with frostbite.

scarlet-violet.text: The user attacks with savagely cold winds that cause both body and spirit to tremble. This may also lower the Speed stats of opposing Pokémon.

legends-arceus.text: The user summons a thunderous tempest and savagely attacks with lightning and wind. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

scarlet-violet.text: The user summons a thunderous tempest and savagely attacks with lightning and wind. This may also leave opposing Pokémon with paralysis.

legends-arceus.text: The user attacks by wrapping the target in fierce winds and searingly hot sand. This also leaves the target with a burn.

scarlet-violet.text: The user attacks by wrapping opposing Pokémon in fierce winds and searingly hot sand. This may also leave them with a burn.

legends-arceus.text: The user heals its own status conditions and restores its HP. Incoming moves also become more likely to miss.

scarlet-violet.text: The user receives a blessing from the crescent moon, restoring HP and curing status conditions for itself and its ally Pokémon currently in the battle.

legends-arceus.text: The user lifts its spirits, healing its own status conditions and raising its offensive and defensive stats.

scarlet-violet.text: The user lifts its spirits, curing its own status conditions and boosting its Sp. Atk and Sp. Def stats.
If the user has Terastallized, it unleashes energy of its Tera Type. This move inflicts damage using the Attack or Sp. Atk stat—whichever is higher for the user.
The user spins a silken trap, protecting itself from damage while lowering the Speed stat of any attacker that makes direct contact.
The user attacks by kicking up into the air and slamming its heel down upon the target. This may also confuse the target. If it misses, the user takes damage instead.
The user attacks to avenge its allies. The more defeated allies there are in the user's party, the greater the move's power.
The user attacks by unleashing a peculiar light that even affects the mind. This also harshly lowers the target's Sp. Def stat.
The user attacks with elegant poise. If the user has a Tatsugiri in its mouth, this move boosts one of the user's stats based on the Tatsugiri's form.
The user summons a torrent around its fist and punches at blinding speed. This move always goes first.
The user emits an incredibly spicy extract, sharply boosting the target's Attack stat and harshly lowering the target's Defense stat.
The user spins furiously by straining its legs, inflicting damage on the target. This also harshly lowers the user's Speed stat.
The user’s fellows gather in droves to perform a combo attack that hits the target one to ten times in a row.
The user covers its feet in thin ice and twirls around, slamming into the target. This move's spinning motion also destroys the terrain.
The user throws its entire body into a reckless charge. After this move is used, attacks on the user cannot miss and will inflict double damage until the user’s next turn.
The user bestows a loving blessing, reviving a party Pokémon that has fainted and restoring half that Pokémon's max HP.
The user salt cures the target, inflicting damage every turn. Steel and Water types are more strongly affected by this move.
The user performs a perfectly timed triple dive, hitting the target with splashes of water three times in a row.
The user performs a spin attack that can also eliminate the effects of such moves as Bind, Wrap, and Leech Seed. This also poisons opposing Pokémon.
The user captures the very essence of the target in a sketch. This changes the Abilities of the user and its ally Pokémon to that of the target.
The user sharply boosts its Attack, Sp. Atk, and Speed stats by using its own HP.
The user slashes at the target after kowtowing to make the target let down its guard. This attack never misses.
The user throws a rigged bouquet of flowers at the target. This attack never misses and always lands a critical hit.
The user blows out raging flames as if singing a song, scorching the target. This also boosts the user's Sp. Atk stat.
The user toys with the target and attacks it using light and fluid dance steps. This also boosts the user's Speed stat.
The user performs a tackle like a raging bull. This move's type depends on the user's form. It can also break barriers, such as Light Screen and Reflect.
The user attacks by throwing out a mass of coins. This also lowers the user's Sp. Atk stat. Money is earned after the battle.
The user rends the target with an ethereal blade. This move's power is boosted by 50 percent if the user is on Electric Terrain.
The user blasts the target with boiling-hot water. This move's power is not lowered in harsh sunlight but rather boosted by 50 percent.
The user summons a ruinous disaster. This cuts the target’s HP in half.
The user transforms and crashes to the ground, causing a massive prehistoric explosion. This move's power is boosted more than usual if it’s a supereffective hit.
The user races forward at ultrafast speeds, piercing its target with futuristic electricity. This move's power is boosted more than usual if it's a supereffective hit.
The user creates a substitute for itself using its own HP before switching places with a party Pokémon in waiting.
The user tells a chillingly bad joke before switching places with a party Pokémon in waiting. This summons a snowstorm lasting five turns.
The user tidies up and removes the effects of Spikes, Stealth Rock, Sticky Web, Toxic Spikes, and Substitute. This also boosts the user’s Attack and Speed stats.
The user summons a snowstorm lasting five turns. This boosts the Defense stats of Ice types.
The user attacks by pouncing on the target. This also lowers the target's Speed stat.
The user attacks suddenly as if leaping out from tall grass. The user's nimble footwork boosts its Speed stat.
The user attacks the target by showering it with water that's so cold it saps the target's power. This also lowers the target's Attack stat.
The user spins the pointed part of its body at high speed to pierce the target. This attack can hit a target using a move such as Protect or Detect.
The user shoots mystical beams from its eyes to inflict damage. The target is hit twice in a row.
The user converts its rage into energy to attack. The more times the user has been hit by attacks, the greater the move's power.
The user shoots its own armor out as blazing projectiles. This also lowers the user’s Defense and Sp. Def stats.
The user focuses its bitter feelings toward the world of the living into a slashing attack. The user's HP is restored by up to half the damage taken by the target.
The user discharges all the electricity from its body to perform a high-damage attack. After using this move, the user will no longer be Electric type.
The user swings its whole body around to attack with its huge hammer. This move can't be used twice in a row.
The user retaliates with much greater force against the opponent that last inflicted damage on it.
The user expels pressurized water to cut at the target like a blade. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.
The user unleashes the full brunt of its spirit from a full moon that shines as red as blood. This move can't be used twice in a row.
The user fires a blast of tea that it mixed. The user's HP is restored by up to half the damage taken by the target. This may also leave the target with a burn.
The user sets off an explosion of sticky candy syrup, which coats the target and causes the target's Speed stat to drop each turn for three turns.
The user strikes with an ivy-wrapped cudgel. This move's type changes depending on the mask worn by the user, and it has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.
The user gathers electricity on the first turn, boosting its Sp. Atk stat, then fires a high-voltage shot on the next turn. The shot will be fired immediately in rain.
With the power of its crystals, the user bombards and eliminates the target. When used by Terapagos in its Stellar Form, this move damages all opposing Pokémon.
The user shoots a beam of light to inflict damage. Sometimes all the user's heads shoot beams in unison, doubling the move's power.
The user's intensely hot fur protects it from attacks and also burns any attacker that makes direct contact with it.
This move enables the user to attack first with a jolt of electricity. This move fails if the target is not readying an attack.
The user wields the light that has accumulated atop its head to cleave the target. This move hits even if the target protects itself.
The user attacks by launching particle blades at the target twice in a row. This attack never misses.
The target is crushed with an arm, a claw, or the like to inflict damage. The more HP the target has left, the greater the move's power.
The user raises its allies’ morale with a draconic cry so that their future attacks have a heightened chance of landing critical hits. This rouses Dragon types more.
The user attacks the target using its angelic voice. This also confuses the target if its stats have been boosted during the turn.
Spurred by desperation, the user attacks the target. This move's power is doubled if the user's previous move failed.
The user electrifies its body and drops onto the target to inflict damage. If this move misses, the user takes damage instead.
The user attacks the target with unpleasant sound waves. For two turns, the target is prevented from recovering HP through moves, Abilities, or held items.
The user reacts to the target's movement and strikes with the heel of its palm, making the target flinch. This move fails if the target is not readying a priority move.
The user pours toxins into the target by wrapping them in a toxic, corrosive chain. This may also leave the target badly poisoned.

shadow-rush.effect: Has an increased chance for a critical hit in Hyper Mode.

shadow-blast.name: Soplo Oscuro
shadow-blast.effect: Has an increased chance for a critical hit.

shadow-blitz.name: Vigor Oscuro
shadow-blitz.effect: Causa daño sin un efecto adicional.

shadow-break.effect: Causa daño sin un efecto adicional.

shadow-end.name: Fin Oscuro
shadow-end.effect: User receives 1/2 its HP in recoil.

shadow-rave.name: Rabia Oscura
shadow-rave.effect: Causa daño sin un efecto adicional.

shadow-storm.effect: Causa daño sin un efecto adicional.

shadow-wave.name: Onda Oscura
shadow-wave.effect: Causa daño sin un efecto adicional.

shadow-down.name: Ocaso Oscuro
shadow-down.effect: Lowers the target’s Defense by two stages.

shadow-half.name: Mitad Oscura
shadow-half.effect: Halves HP of all Pokémon on the field.  Must recharge

shadow-hold.name: Traba Oscura
shadow-hold.effect: Prevents the target from leaving battle.

shadow-mist.name: Bruma Oscura
shadow-mist.effect: Lowers the target’s evasion by two stages.

shadow-shed.name: Muda Oscura
shadow-shed.effect: Removes Light Screen, Reflect, and Safeguard.

shadow-sky.name: Cielo Oscuro
shadow-sky.effect: Changes the weather to Shadow Sky for five turns.

stench.name: Hedor
stench.effect:
This Pokémon's damaging moves have a 10% chance to make the target flinch with each hit if they do not already cause flinching as a secondary effect.

This ability does not stack with a held item.

Overworld: The wild encounter rate is halved while this Pokémon is first in the party.

ruby-sapphire.text: Helps repel wild POKéMON.

emerald.text: Helps repel wild POKéMON.

firered-leafgreen.text: Helps repel wild POKéMON.

diamond-pearl.text: The stench helps keep wild Pokémon away.

platinum.text: The stench helps keep wild Pokémon away.

heartgold-soulsilver.text: The stench helps keep wild Pokémon away.

black-white.text: The stench may cause the target to flinch.

black-2-white-2.text: The stench may cause the target to flinch.

x-y.text: Es posible que el rival retroceda por el mal olor.

omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire.text: Es posible que el rival retroceda por el mal olor.

sun-moon.text: Debido al mal olor que emana, al atacar al rival puede hacerlo retroceder.

ultra-sun-ultra-moon.text: Debido al mal olor que emana, al atacar al rival puede hacerlo retroceder.

lets-go-pikachu-lets-go-eevee.text: Debido al mal olor que emana, al atacar al rival puede hacerlo retroceder.

sword-shield.text: Puede amedrentar al rival al atacarlo debido al mal olor que emana.

scarlet-violet.text: By releasing a stench when attacking, the Pokémon may cause the target to flinch.

drizzle.name: Llovizna
drizzle.effect:
The weather changes to rain when this Pokémon enters battle and does not end unless replaced by another weather condition.

If multiple Pokémon with this ability, Drought, Sand Stream, or Snow Warning are sent out at the same time, the abilities will activate in order of Speed, respecting Trick Room.  Each ability's weather will cancel the previous weather, and only the weather summoned by the slowest of the Pokémon will stay.

ruby-sapphire.text: Summons rain in battle.

emerald.text: Summons rain in battle.

firered-leafgreen.text: Summons rain in battle.

diamond-pearl.text: The Pokémon makes it rain if it appears in battle.

platinum.text: The Pokémon makes it rain if it appears in battle.

heartgold-soulsilver.text: The Pokémon makes it rain if it appears in battle.

black-white.text: The Pokémon makes it rain if it appears in battle.

black-2-white-2.text: The Pokémon makes it rain if it appears in battle.

x-y.text: Hace que llueva cuando entra en combate.

omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire.text: Hace que llueva cuando entra en combate.

sun-moon.text: Hace que llueva cuando entra en combate.

ultra-sun-ultra-moon.text: Hace que llueva cuando entra en combate.

lets-go-pikachu-lets-go-eevee.text: Hace que llueva cuando entra en combate.

sword-shield.text: Hace que llueva al entrar en combate.

scarlet-violet.text: The Pokémon makes it rain when it enters a battle.

speed-boost.name: Impulso
speed-boost.effect: This Pokémon's Speed rises one stage after each turn.

ruby-sapphire.text: Gradually boosts SPEED.

emerald.text: Gradually boosts SPEED.

firered-leafgreen.text: Gradually boosts SPEED.

diamond-pearl.text: The Pokémon’s Speed stat is gradually boosted.

platinum.text: The Pokémon’s Speed stat is gradually boosted.

heartgold-soulsilver.text: Its Speed stat is gradually boosted.

truant.name: Ausente
truant.effect:
Every second turn on which this Pokémon should attempt to use a move, it will instead do nothing ("loaf around").

Loafing around interrupts moves that take multiple turns the same way paralysis, flinching, etc do.  Most such moves, for example Bide or Rollout, are simply cut off upon loafing around.  Attacks with a recharge turn, such as Hyper Beam, do not have to recharge; attacks with a preparation turn, such as Fly, do not end up being used.  Moves that are forced over multiple turns and keep going through failure, such as Outrage, Uproar, or any move forced by Encore, keep going as usual.

If this Pokémon is confused, its confusion is not checked when loafing around; the Pokémon cannot hurt itself, and its confusion does not end or come closer to ending.

If this Pokémon attempts to move but fails, e.g. because of paralysis or Gravity, it still counts as having moved and will loaf around the next turn.  If it does not attempt to move, e.g. because it is asleep or frozen, whatever it would have done will be postponed until its next attempt; that is, it will either loaf around or move as usual, depending on what it last did.

This ability cannot be changed with Worry Seed, but it can be disabled with Gastro Acid, changed with Role Play, or traded away with Skill Swap.

This Pokémon's moves completely ignore abilities that could hinder or prevent their effect on the target.

For example, this Pokémon's moves ignore abilities that would fully negate them, such as Water Absorb; abilities that would prevent any of their effects, such as Clear Body, Shell Armor, or Sticky Hold; and abilities that grant any general protective benefit, such as Simple, Snow Cloak, or Thick Fat.  If an ability could either hinder or help this Pokémon's moves, e.g. Dry Skin or Unaware, the ability is ignored either way.

Abilities that do not fit this description, even if they could hinder moves in some other way, are not affected.  For example, Cursed Body only affects potential future uses of the move, while Liquid Ooze and Shadow Tag can only hinder a move's effect on the user.  This ablity cannot ignore type or form changes granted by abilities, for example Color Change or Forecast; nor effects that were caused by abilities but are no longer tied to an ability, such as the rain from Drizzle.  This ability cannot ignore Multitype at all.

An ability ignored by this ability is only nullified while the move is being used.  For example, this Pokémon's moves can paralyze a Pokémon with Limber, but Limber will activate and heal the paralysis immediately thereafter, and this Pokémon's Spikes are not affected by this ability after they have been placed.

When this Pokémon enters battle, all participating trainers are notified that it has this ability.

This ability functions identically to Teravolt and Turboblaze.

This Pokémon's held item, whether or not it is a Plate, cannot be taken by Covet or Thief, nor removed by Knock Off, nor traded by Switcheroo or Trick.  Covet, Thief, and Knock Off still inflict damage against this Pokémon.  Unlike with Sticky Hold, this Pokémon cannot use Fling, Switcheroo, or Trick to lose its item itself, nor gain an item through Switcheroo or Trick if it does not have one.

This ability has no effect for any Pokémon other than Arceus.  This ability cannot be traded with Skill Swap, nor copied with Role Play or Trace, nor disabled with Gastro Acid, nor changed with Worry Seed.  This Pokémon cannot use Skill Swap or Role Play to lose its ability itself.  Mold Breaker cannot ignore this ability.

If a Pokémon Transforms into an Arceus with this ability, it will Transform into Arceus's default, Normal-type form.  If the Transforming Pokémon is holding a Plate, this ability will then activate and change the Pokémon into the corresponding form.

turboblaze.name: Turbollama
turboblaze.effect:
This Pokémon's moves completely ignore abilities that could hinder or prevent their effect on the target.

For example, this Pokémon's moves ignore abilities that would fully negate them, such as Water Absorb; abilities that would prevent any of their effects, such as Clear Body, Shell Armor, or Sticky Hold; and abilities that grant any general protective benefit, such as Simple, Snow Cloak, or Thick Fat.  If an ability could either hinder or help this Pokémon's moves, e.g. Dry Skin or Unaware, the ability is ignored either way.

Abilities that do not fit this description, even if they could hinder moves in some other way, are not affected.  For example, Cursed Body only affects potential future uses of the move, while Liquid Ooze and Shadow Tag can only hinder a move's effect on the user.  This ablity cannot ignore type or form changes granted by abilities, for example Color Change or Forecast; nor effects that were caused by abilities but are no longer tied to an ability, such as the rain from Drizzle.  This ability cannot ignore Multitype at all.

An ability ignored by this ability is only nullified while the move is being used.  For example, this Pokémon's moves can paralyze a Pokémon with Limber, but Limber will activate and heal the paralysis immediately thereafter, and this Pokémon's Spikes are not affected by this ability after they have been placed.

When this Pokémon enters battle, all participating trainers are notified that it has this ability.

This ability functions identically to Mold Breaker and Teravolt.
